# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and Graphite** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU bindings across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. This release adds asynchronous pixel readback, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, strengthens object lifetime handling, and includes broad renderer servicing fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent m151 and m152 servicing fixes, including the Chrome m152 UAF correction. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to adopt the newer rendering architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support for non-blocking pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — Restores production of the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for consumers using Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel-source lifetime handling corrected** — Keeps native pixel sources alive while creating pixmap subsets and derived pixmaps, preventing use-after-free failures. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster image allocation failure no longer leaks memory** — Releases the allocated pixel buffer when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKRegion iteration lifetime fixed** — Roots the source SKRegion while its SpanIterator is in use, preventing a native use-after-free. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Runtime effect uniform buffers are released on reset** — Disposes the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support expanded** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server deployments. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding an unnecessary feature-array copy and fixes the non-memory-backed stream path used to create blobs.
